# R11D C89 coverage (generated by scripts/r11d-coverage.py)

Status is taken from the exported symbols of the built libraries, not from headers.
Macros, constants and types are listed for completeness and are not counted as implemented here.

Status: implemented = exported and working; partial = working with a documented restriction;
blocked = exported but always fails explicitly (kernel or filesystem service absent);
missing = not exported; defined = macro or type present in the installed header.
guest_tested: yes = a program in the R11D run list names the symbol; no = named only by a program outside the run list; none = no test names it.

| status | rows |
|---|---|
| blocked | 14 |
| defined | 59 |
| implemented | 110 |
| missing | 5 |
| partial | 12 |
